summary: Punakha district is overwhelmingly forested, with 910.69 km² (82.0%) of its area covered by forest. The remaining land is largely alpine scrub (73.16 km², 6.6%) and agriculture land (50.93 km², 4.6%), with small proportions of shrubs, meadows, and other features. Only minimal areas are occupied by built‑up or water bodies, each less than 1 % of the district.
